Name: Heber, Father of Socho
Summary: Son of Mered by Jehudijah, called the father of Socho.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:18: Son of Mered by Jehudijah, called the father of Socho.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Heber stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
